career_ladder.note: Officers recruited through the Haryana Civil Services (Executive Branch) examination are appointed under the Haryana Civil Service (Executive Branch) Rules, 2008. They commence as Sub-Divisional Magistrates (SDM) / City Magistrates / Assistant Commissioners and advance through state administrative echelons before induction into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) Haryana Cadre under the IAS (Appointment by Promotion) Regulations, 1955.

exam_scheme.note: The HCS (Executive Branch) and Allied Services examination comprises three successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective screening of 200 marks across 2 papers), Main Written Examination (Conventional descriptive across 6 compulsory papers of 100 marks each, 600 marks total; optional subjects eliminated vide Haryana Government Gazette Notification No. 42/1/2018-5SII dated 07.01.2026 and Advt. No. 22/2026), and Personality Test / Viva-Voce (75 marks). Final selection merit is prepared out of 675 marks.

stages.source_label: HPSC Advt. No. 22/2026 & Gazette Notification No. 42/1/2018-5SII dated 07.01.2026

papers.negative_marking: 0.25 marks (one-fourth) deducted for each incorrect response. Mandatory 5th bubble rule: if question is unattempted, candidate must darken circle 'E'; failing to darken any of the five circles incurs 0.25 mark deduction; leaving circles unattempted in more than 10% questions leads to disqualification.
papers.qualifying_threshold: Screening paper only; marks determine qualification for Mains examination (subject to scoring 33% in Paper II)

papers.paper_name: Paper II: Civil Services Aptitude Test (CSAT)
papers.negative_marking: 0.25 marks (one-fourth) deducted for each incorrect response. Fifth option circle rule applies identically.
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying score fixed at 33% (33 marks out of 100). Marks are qualifying only and not counted towards the Preliminary ranking list.

papers.qualifying_threshold: Interview board evaluates mental alertness, critical powers of assimilation, clear exposition, balance of judgment, leadership, intellectual integrity, and suitability for public service. Candidates equal to 3 times the number of vacancies are summoned based on Main written exam marks.

financial_package.note: Officers in the Haryana Civil Services (Executive Branch) and Haryana Police Service (DSP) are remunerated under the Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 at Functional Pay Level FPL-10 (pre-revised PB-3 ₹15,600–39,100 + Grade Pay ₹5,400) with entry basic pay of ₹56,100. Allied service cadres (e.g. AETO, TM, Naib Tehsildar) are placed in Functional Pay Levels FPL-9 (₹53,100) or FPL-7/8.
financial_package.pay_level: Haryana Functional Pay Level FPL-10 (Pre-revised PB-3 ₹15,600 - ₹39,100 + Grade Pay ₹5,400)
financial_package.pay_source_label: HPSC Advt. No. 22/2026 & Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 FPL-10
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary computed from Haryana Functional Pay Level FPL-10 entry basic ₹56,100 + 58% DA (₹32,538) + House Rent Allowance (HRA 9% to 27-30% depending on city classification: Gurugram/Faridabad Category X at 27-30%, Panchkula/Ambala/Rohtak Category Y at 18-20%, rural/small towns Category Z at 9-10%) + fixed medical allowance (₹1,000). In-hand estimate accounts for statutory deductions including 10% NPS contribution (Basic + DA = ₹8,864), Group Insurance Scheme (GIS), and Haryana Professional Tax.
official_perks: Designated official government accommodation or entitled House Rent Allowance (HRA up to 27-30% in Gurugram/Faridabad, 18-20% in Panchkula and major district headquarters)
Official vehicle with driver and monthly fuel quota for field inspections and executive duties (SDM, DSP, ETO)
Government telephone, mobile reimbursement, and broadband allowances as per Haryana Finance Department norms
Comprehensive medical coverage and cashless hospitalization for self and family under Haryana Government health schemes
Encashment of earned leave and leave travel concession (LTC) once in a block of 4 years
Security detail and residential guard for sensitive field executive postings (SDM, City Magistrate, DSP)
